about.text: A Dutch sheep cheese made for centuries on Texel, and also on Wieringen and Terschelling. Fresh sheep droppings are said to be infused into the sheep's milk, colouring the cheese green and giving it its sharp taste. Its making is said to have stopped around 1860.

sources.text: Sheep milk, the droppings infusion, the accidental discovery, the spread to Wieringen and Terschelling, and the end around 1860.
